description: The source names this dataset for a poster on MIL-125(Ti) and MIL-125-NH2(Ti) metal-organic frameworks used to remove disinfection byproducts. It establishes a specific water-treatment material comparison and identifies the related poster. Metadata do not state the exact compounds tested, measurement format, catalyst loading, illumination conditions or removal rates. The independently named PCN-222 and carbon-nanotube/MOF datasets are separate deposits; a shared research team does not establish identical observations. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is not stated. The source marks the data restricted while publishing CC BY 4.0 metadata. No access procedure, fee, availability date or permission to obtain the underlying files is established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
